dlp.tour.steps.profiles.title: Profiles decide what counts as sensitive
dlp.tour.steps.profiles.description: A DLP profile groups the detection entries you care about, such as card numbers, credentials, or health records. When content matches a profile, the product scanning it can log or block it.
dlp.tour.steps.entries.title: Start from predefined entries, add your own
dlp.tour.steps.entries.description: Turn on entries that Cloudflare maintains for financial, identity, credential, and health data. Add custom entries with a regular expression, or match exact data from a dataset you upload.
dlp.tour.steps.threshold.title: Tune how strict matching is
dlp.tour.steps.threshold.description: A higher confidence threshold needs more validation before an entry matches, so you see fewer false positives. A match count stops policies from firing on a single stray number.
dlp.tour.steps.test_scan.title: Try a profile before you roll it out
dlp.tour.steps.test_scan.description: Paste sample text or upload a file in Test scan to see exactly which entries match. No traffic goes through Gateway, so you can iterate safely.
dlp.tour.steps.channels.title: Put your profile to work
dlp.tour.steps.channels.description: A profile does nothing on its own. Add it to a Gateway HTTP policy, AI prompt protection, a CASB integration, or an email rule to start scanning.
